questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Difficult. Was not allowed SIT housing, since I am from Denmark. I could not find housing on
finn.no
since I don't have norwegian bankID. My only option was
hybel.no
, where I wrote to around 30 renters. Find affordable housing was very difficult for only one semester.
